values.note: $21 per site in 2026, and the same in recreation.gov's 2027 table. One RV with tow vehicle per site; an extra vehicle is charged per night at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/elliott-creek-campground ('Single Site: $21 per night'; last updated May 19, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10122789/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: StandardNonelectric 21) + recreation.gov notice on extra vehicles, read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 10122789 (every site NONELECTRIC) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10122789 (notice 'No drinking water available at this campground'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: recreation.gov: '20 standard sites suitable for tents and smaller trailers'; the catalog has 17 standard sites, 2 tent-only sites and a management site. Mostly parallel parking; driveways 11-60 ft where listed (sites 4, 11 and 20 at 60 ft; 13 and 20 pull-through). Neither page states a maximum length.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10122789 (Facilities, quoted) + campsite catalog for 10122789 (site types, Driveway Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-26

values.note: No day use. The boat ramp is across the reservoir at Heeney Marina, where motorboats must launch after a mandatory ANS inspection.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/elliott-creek-campground ('Vault Toilet', 'Potable water is not available at this site', 'The boat ramp is across the reservoir at the town of Heeney. All motorboats must be launched from Heeney Marina') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10122789 ('No Day Use available at this campground'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov for the 2026 season May 20 - Oct 1 (same dates in 2027), closing 3 days before arrival; every public site is reservable in the catalog. A reserved site is held until 11 a.m. the day after arrival and must be occupied the first night. 14-day stay limit; no weekend minimum (rules set to 0).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10122789 (facility_rules reservationCutOff 3, weekend minimums 0 soft; notices quoted) + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-20 to 10-01) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/elliott-creek-campground ('a stay limit of 14 days'), read 2026-10-26

note: On the northwest side of Green Mountain Reservoir just past the dam and the town of Heeney, on Heeney Road (CR 30) off Hwy 9 (Dillon RD, White River NF). Site access is difficult when the road is wet (recreation.gov). The Green Mountain Reservoir boat ramp was closed for the 2026 season for low water (FS alert). --Claude
summary: Confirmed $21 (2026, 2027), no electric, 19 public sites, reservable on recreation.gov. Added reservable season 05-20 to 10-01, 3-day cutoff, 14-day limit, pull-throughs, no water, vault toilets. No maximum length stated anywhere (driveways 11-60 ft), so none recorded. No season statement on the FS page. Note: dropped field repeats; added the wet-road caveat and the 2026 boat-ramp closure.
flags: Water claim lead: the FS page says the campground is 'Located on the northwest shore of Green Mountain Reservoir' (recreation.gov: 'northwest side ... to the south of the dam'); the entry is 'lakeview'. Worth a waterfront re-audit.

Access: recreation.gov notice 'Site access is difficult when road is wet'; no 4WD/high-clearance wording. recreation.gov describes the sites as 'suitable for tents and smaller trailers' (most driveways are parallel pull-offs; several 25-60 ft).

Entry phone is empty. recreation.gov facility phone 970-468-7681; Dillon Ranger District (970) 468-5400 (fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/offices); concessionaire American Land and Leisure 801-226-3564 (recreation.gov customer service).
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/elliott-creek-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
